newsitem.title: UK: CE posts offer document for Northern.
newsitem.headline: CE posts offer document for Northern.

text.p: CE Electric, the bidding vehicle owned by US firms CalEnergy Co Inc and Peter Kiewit Sons' Inc, said on Tuesday it was formally posting its offer document for British electricity distributor Northern Electric Plc.

The cash offer, at 630p per ordinary share and 103p per preference share, was launched last week but under UK merger and acquisition regulations the bid approach is not considered to have begun until documentation has been posted to shareholders.

A statement from the bidders quoted CE Electric chairman and chief excutive David Sokol as saying, "Since the announcement of the offers, shareholders have already sold approximately 13.4 percent of the ordinary shares to us, thereby making CE Electric the largest shareholder...and endorsing the attractive value presented by our cash offers."
Last Friday analysts predicted that Northern was set to rush out a glowing set of half year figures once a bid is lodged with the aim of persuading the market that the CE bid is too low.
The results are therefore expected any time this week, industry sources said.
